purpose: Audit-safe commodity classification layer for LMPC packaged-commodity scanning.
IMPORTANT_STATUS: Prototype classification dataset. It must not be used as a standalone final legal decision engine.

source_policy.required_source: Uploaded consolidated/legal source PDFs and authoritative amendments
source_policy.reason: The retrieved project files contain the classification specification, but an independently retrievable consolidated legal PDF was not present in the retrieved file results for this generation. Legal mappings are therefore explicitly marked SOURCE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED rather than falsely claimed as independently verified.
source_policy.project_specification_basis: The uploaded LMCS project specification requires commodity_class, full Second/Fourth Schedule mapping, effective dating, applicability gates and human review.

classification_output_contract.auto_decision_rule: Auto-classify only when one candidate exceeds the threshold and no high-priority conflicting candidate remains.
classification_output_contract.conflict_rule: If two candidates are close in score or a higher-priority exclusion is triggered, return AMBIGUOUS/HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
classification_output_contract.legal_safety_rule: Category classification never directly produces a final compliance decision.

second_schedule.required_engine_behavior: If and only if a dated legal source confirms the entry is active, evaluate exact permitted sizes or multiples-of-N rules. Do not rely on category keywords alone.

negative_and_exception_cases.NO_MATCH: No category meets minimum evidence threshold.
negative_and_exception_cases.AMBIGUOUS: Two or more plausible categories remain after scoring.
negative_and_exception_cases.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: OCR/product name is incomplete, unreadable, or contradictory.
negative_and_exception_cases.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Commodity-specific legal mapping, scope, exemption, or rule version cannot be established safely.
negative_and_exception_cases.CONFLICTING_OCR_VISION: OCR and Vision model disagree materially on product identity.
negative_and_exception_cases.EXCLUSION_CONFLICT: A negative keyword/exclusion conflicts with a positive category match.
negative_and_exception_cases.unknown_unit: Unit is missing or cannot be normalized.
negative_and_exception_cases.unknown_package_type: Retail/wholesale context is unavailable where relevant.

effective_date_model.evaluation_rule: Only use a mapping whose effective interval contains evaluation_date.
effective_date_model.amendment_behavior: New version supersedes old mapping; never mutate historical evaluation results.
